not_guaranteed: Reproducibility or bit-identity with upstream's own CI.
Absence of vulnerabilities in the wheels or their dependencies.
Offline compilation: the build fetches crates and git dependencies.
Any audit of wheel contents beyond the checks above.
That the recorded rustc is the one that compiled: it is recorded by the checkout step in the same image before the compile.
That the build log is attested: it is released as an asset, not as an attested subject.
File modification times: they are normalized to the commit time, contents are unmodified.
The release tag is pinned to the build commit but is not signed.
The post-build tree check is logged by build.sh, not attested.
SBOM and VEX for the wheels are not part of this policy version.

rules.statement: The upstream-source attestation records the builder image as <image>@sha256:<digest>, and that digest appears in builder.lock for the wheel's architecture.
rules.title: Builder image pinned by digest

rules.statement: The attested upstream repo, tag and 40-hex commit match the release inputs, tree_clean is true (checked before the build; the post-build tree check is performed by build.sh and logged, not attested), and the released source archive has the attested sha256.
rules.title: Unmodified upstream source

rules.statement: The attested rustc version satisfies the channel in rust-toolchain.toml of the archived upstream source. A minor channel such as 1.96 matches any 1.96.x, a full version must match exactly, and stable/beta/nightly fail.
rules.title: Compiler satisfies upstream channel

rules.statement: SLSA provenance verifies with the signer workflow, an allowed source ref and the build commit, and records the same workflow path, repository, ref and commit.
rules.title: Build provenance from the pinned workflow

rules.statement: The attested policy_sha256 equals the sha256 of the published policy.json, and the attested policy_version equals this policy's version.
rules.title: Built under this exact policy

rules.statement: The release holds exactly each wheel, its attestation bundle, the attested source archive and one build log.
rules.title: Release asset set

rules.statement: Every external action used by the build and release workflows is pinned to a full commit SHA.
rules.title: Workflow actions pinned

rules.statement: The upstream-source attestation carries exactly the required fields: none missing, none unexpected.
rules.title: Predicate is complete

rules.statement: The attested sha256 of checkout_verify.py and build.sh equals the sha256 of those files at the build commit.
rules.title: Build scripts are the committed ones

rules.statement: The builder.lock used for verification is byte-identical to builder.lock at the build commit.
rules.title: Builder lock is the committed one

rules.statement: The release target is the build commit, and once published the tag ref resolves to that commit.
rules.title: Release tag pinned to the build commit

rules.evidence: GitHub-hosted ubuntu runner, GitHub Actions OIDC, Sigstore public-good instance, the cosign binary installed by the pinned installer action.
rules.statement: The build runs on a GitHub-hosted runner and signs through GitHub and Sigstore. These are trusted, not verified here.
rules.title: Trust root: runner and signing

rules.evidence: Alpine APKs, rustup and Rust toolchain archives, crates.io tarballs, and the upstream git dependencies sdf-labs/arrow-rs, sdf-labs/datafusion, sdf-labs/ring, sdf-labs/datafusion-sqlparser-rs, dbt-labs/arrow-adbc, astral-sh/ruff. libgcc_s.so.1 from the builder image is grafted into the wheels.
rules.statement: Inputs fetched at build time are trusted, not verified here. The grafted libgcc_s.so.1 is covered by the builder image SBOM.
rules.title: Trust root: packages and sources

summary: Wheels are built in a builder image whose digest matches builder.lock, from an unmodified upstream tag, by a pinned workflow on main. Each rule below is verified at release by verify_wheel_policy.py against the attestations on the wheels. Declared rules are trust roots: recorded, not verified.
